name: cone-6-glaze-30min-hold
description: Cone 6 glaze for a full kiln: 316C/h (570F/h) to 800C, 200C/h to 1083C (the most the elements manage there), 111C/h (200F/h) to 1222C, then a 30 minute hold. The middle of a full load can run up to 15C behind the thermocouple (cone 05 bisque, Nov 2026); heat-work model: cone 6.0-6.3 in the middle of the load, up to cone 7 near the thermocouple wall.
